name: Ranko-san
source:
The Madonna of the radio calisthenics that are the protagonist's daily routine.

She's a good confidante and understanding friend to the protagonist, who struggles with family debt and relationships with her sisters.

Her flaw? She tends to blurt out dirty things in a loud voice?

"Right? I love giving blowjobs too♪ You just feel the love, don't you?"

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080916184540/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/feralym/chara.html] archived official site[/url]]
